text.headline: Title slide
text.text: This will be the title slide. It will show a zoomed-out version of your image to the left. We can have a background image behind this text if we like.

text.headline: First slide
text.text: This is the first slide. When it loads, the image at left zooms in to a specified location. The text here will describe what's noteworthy about the location we've zoomed to. Currently, a basic map pin appears at the specified location. This could be swapped out for a different icon, but it's also possible to have no icon at all. Unless there's a particular need to mark a highly specific place on the image, it's probably less distracting to omit the icon altogether.

text.headline: Second slide
text.text: When the second slide loads, we move to a new location. The text here will describe what's noteworthy about the new location. As with the title slide and all slides, we can have a background image behind the text as well as an image at the top of the text box.

text.headline: Third slide
text.text: The third slide zooms to yet another location. Text here will describe what's noteworthy about the new location.
